title: Model Parallelism & Topology
description: Study tensor parallel matrix operations, pipeline stages and bubbles, expert parallelism and routing load, and multi-dimensional parallel strategies. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Tensor parallel matrix operations
lessons.description: Draw a row-wise and column-wise partition and identify required communication.
lessons.conceptOverview: Tensor parallelism divides parts of a layer's computation across devices. The partition determines where partial results must be combined or exchanged. Frequent communication makes interconnect topology important; spreading tightly coupled shards across slow links can erase compute gains.
lessons.whyItMatters: Choose partitions with their communication requirements and topology in mind.

lessons.title: Pipeline stages and bubbles
lessons.description: Partition eight unequal-cost layers into stages and estimate the slowest stage.
lessons.conceptOverview: Pipeline parallelism places layer groups on different devices and schedules microbatches through them. Fill and drain periods create bubbles. Balancing stage cost and increasing useful in-flight work can help, but memory and scheduling complexity limit the design.
lessons.whyItMatters: Balance measured stage cost rather than only layer count.

lessons.title: Expert parallelism and routing load
lessons.description: Define metrics for tokens per expert, dropped or rerouted tokens, and communication time.
lessons.conceptOverview: Expert parallelism distributes MoE experts across devices and routes token activations to them. Uneven routing can overload particular experts or links. Capacity policies, balancing objectives, and all-to-all communication contribute to quality and performance tradeoffs.
lessons.whyItMatters: Inspect routing imbalance alongside aggregate GPU utilization.

lessons.title: Multi-dimensional parallel strategies
lessons.description: Map a hypothetical two-node cluster into parallel groups and justify the placement.
lessons.conceptOverview: Large jobs can combine data, tensor, pipeline, and expert parallelism. Each dimension has different memory and communication behavior. Map frequent communication to fast links and choose dimensions based on model structure, workload, and topology rather than a single universal recipe.
lessons.whyItMatters: Parallel-group placement should reflect the frequency and cost of communication.
